summary: 500 Global’s current Flagship Accelerator information is published on its official Founder Programs and Aplica pages. The old supplied URL now returns a not-available page, but the active official pages say Batch 37 applications are open and the batch starts in Q2 2026. No exact application deadline or program dates are publicly listed.

proposed_event.name: 500 Global Flagship Accelerator Batch 37
proposed_event.description: Palo Alto accelerator offering $150K, mentorship, curriculum, and founder network for early-stage tech startups.

dates.date_range_text: Accepting applications for Batch 37; batch starts Q2 2026. Exact deadline and program dates are not published.

sources.title: Aplica - 500 Global Flagship Accelerator
sources.supports: Official application landing page states the Flagship Accelerator invests in early-stage tech startups across regions and industries, is hosted at 500 Global headquarters in Palo Alto, is accepting applications for Batch 37, and Batch 37 starts in Q2 2026.

sources.title: Flagship Accelerator | 500 Global
sources.supports: Official program page describes the four-month in-person Silicon Valley program, $150,000 investment, founder programming, curriculum, mentorship, network access, and $1M+ in FounderHub credits/perks.

sources.title: Founder Programs | 500 Global
sources.supports: Official founder programs page lists Flagship Accelerator as an active USA program and says it invests in early-stage tech startups across regions and industries from Palo Alto.

sources.title: 500 Global unavailable page
sources.supports: The originally supplied accelerator URL returns a not-available page, indicating the current official program URL has moved.

notes: The active official flagship URL is https://500.co/founders/flagship; the supplied https://500.co/accelerators/flagship URL is no longer available.

The 500.co/founders/flagship page contains a stale-looking December 2024/Batch 36 application-close banner, so the current Batch 37 application status and Q2 2026 cadence are taken from the official Aplica landing page.
Exact application open date, application deadline, program start date, program end date, demo day, and timezone were not publicly posted.
